needle.text: Deal 2 damage to an enemy player or Neighbor.

thunder.text: Deal 4 damage to an enemy player or Neighbor.

padding.text: Give a friendly Neighbor +2 permanent armor.

growth.text: Give a friendly Neighbor +2 attack and +2 maximum and current health.

knot.text: Exhaust an enemy Neighbor. It refreshes on its next turn.

return.text: Return any Neighbor to its owner hand, removing its battlefield bonuses.

erasure.text: Exile an enemy Tool, Habit, Envoy or Undertaking.

drizzle.text: Deal 1 damage to every enemy Neighbor simultaneously.

dice.text: Roll a seeded d6: 1-2 restore 3 composure; 3-4 draw one; 5-6 deal 3 damage to the opponent.

blade.text: Your Neighbors in this district have +1 attack.

roof.text: Your Neighbors in this district have +1 armor.

morning.text: At the start of your turn, restore 1 composure.

ink.text: Once on your main turn, pay 1 focus: draw one card.

warmth.text: Once on your main turn, pay 1 focus: restore 3 composure.

courier.text: Once on your main turn, pay 1 focus: deal 1 damage to the opponent.

task.text: Complete with your own attacks: gain 2 accord and draw one card. An enemy destroying it gives no reward.

new_sweep_1.text: Deal 1 damage to every enemy Neighbor.

new_sweep_2.text: Deal 2 damage to every enemy Neighbor.

new_sweep_3.text: Deal 3 damage to every enemy Neighbor.

new_sweep_4.text: Deal 4 damage to every enemy Neighbor.

new_start_heal_1.text: At the start of your turn, restore 1 composure.

new_start_heal_2.text: At the start of your turn, restore 2 composure.

new_start_heal_3.text: At the start of your turn, restore 3 composure.

new_start_draw_cards_1.text: At the start of your turn, draw one card.

new_start_deal_damage_1.text: At the start of your turn, deal 1 damage to the opponent.

new_start_deal_damage_2.text: At the start of your turn, deal 2 damage to the opponent.

new_start_deal_damage_3.text: At the start of your turn, deal 3 damage to the opponent.
